summary: The page adheres strictly to its assigned brief, chapter boundaries, and research sources. Factual claims from NIST RPD-G-07, APG Documenting Nonconformity, and APG Review and Closing are accurately quoted and framed with appropriate caveats regarding ISO 9001:2015 auditor guidance and laboratory context. The text covers classification, immediate containment assignment, linking affected records, and checking containment evidence. Practical evaluation criteria, workflow decisions, inputs, roles, records, exceptions, and consistently labeled hypothetical examples featuring an unnamed machining manufacturer are present in each subsection. No unassigned FAQ section was included.
